posts.name: fba827
posts.cooked:
So based on Shattered Timelines preview information we know that ....

Heroes: Omnitron-X, Chrono-Ranger

Villains: Iron legacy, Dreamer, La Capitan, Kismet

Environments: Time Cataclysm, The Block

(not counting miniexpansions or promotionals)

 

With that said, with Shattered Timelines being sent out over the next few weeks ...

I do not doubt that they will all be fun and will all get played by me very quickly... but which hero are you looking to try first? which villain first? which environment first?

it can be for reasons for mechanics or story or whatever...

 

personally?  as said i will quickly try them all out, but i think the ones i'm looking forward to trying first are omnitron-x, dreamer, and the block.  the reason for those choices is purely personal preference (for hero, the story for omnitron-x appeals to me more; for villain it sounds like a different game mechanic to try; and for environment just curious to see how they did it)

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
Well, I've promised to not read through Miss Information before playing her for the first time, but I do think she's my most anticipated antagonist. But, no matter, as she is a mini-expansion and thus not technically a part of Shattered Timelines.

 

I'd go with Dreamer (Visionary is one of my favourite characters and I am very excited to see her story continue, especially in such interesting mechanics), Chrono-Ranger (while I don't think much of him as a character, I know we'll get along swimmingly mechanicaly, which is far more important in the long run), and Time Cataclysm (mostly to see what is there, really).

 

I can safely and happily say that I don't see any portion of this expansion sitting in the box forever being talked about more than actually played, very much unlike Her Avian Majesty or a certain grafitti-specked city.

Sorry, I'm including the mini-expansions because I'm so excited about all of it.

I feel that very little has been released about Miss Information. The mystery is impossible to ignore. I agree on no reading through her deck before playing her. That would wreck the mystery. (If I have to pick a ST villain it'd be the Dreamer since we'll be rescuing her. Rescuing victims from Spite isn't always satisfying.)

The Scholar looks fun, but I have to know how what pieces of the old Omnitron are in Omnitron-X's deck. If it puts out hero target drones it could rival Unity as my favorite hero.

Is the Time Cataclysm a collection of old environment cards? Which ones? (That was a rhetorical question. Don't spoil my surprise.)

posts.name: Alex
posts.cooked:
Kismet! Either we'll win or I'll beat everyone else! XD

That aside, I want to fight Iron Legacy, because I never got around to playesting his final version.

All the villains are pretty unusual this time around! Most "conventional" is probably La Capitán, in that she's a big boss with a bunch of underlings to fight. That's actually the level of detail needed to differenciate the ST villains from each other! It's great.

Chrono-Ranger is my most anticipated within ST, The Scholar if we're counting mini expansions, and the Argent Adept if we're including all the heroes I will now have access to.

Oh, and BlueHairedMeerkat, from my experience Kismet is a bit tricky for new players. Her specialty is making everyone's decisions more difficult and offering extra ways to plan ahead, which can be daunting. The Dreamer will be easier( I think) for new people to grasp; there's things to fight and one thing you protect, but everybody usually has something to do.
